tickets.title: Run Liquidity Planning Check
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, available reserves, upcoming withdrawals, and any planned large expenses before recommending trades or distributions. Update the cash reserve for Asha and Ronan Velvetreed given Ronan's consulting project ending and likely gap before the next engagement, which changes the household's reserve target before any equity sale proceeds are assumed. Checking and savings balances at Teacup Comet Bank total about $212,000, including $70,000 earmarked for estimated taxes and property taxes.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-13 is to update the cash reserve.

tickets.title: Prepare Moonbadger Robotics concentration analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison of selling a portion of vested Moonbadger Robotics shares versus holding through the next open window for Asha and Ronan Velvetreed, using tax lots from the Velvet Acorn Custody brokerage account and the stock plan account. The Moonbadger Robotics share price used for the discussion was $52.40.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-08 is to prepare the concentration analysis for Moonbadger Robotics holdings.

tickets.title: Develop portfolio concentration comfort range
tickets.text: Develop a target concentration range for Moonbadger Robotics holdings for Asha and Ronan Velvetreed that accounts for future restricted stock unit vesting. Moonbadger Robotics stock represents about 58% of the $1.84 million taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody as of 2024-02-23, materially above the household's stated comfort level.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-20 is to develop the portfolio concentration comfort range.

tickets.title: Review Moonbadger Robotics trading-window compliance
tickets.text: Review whether a planned Moonbadger Robotics share sale can be entered before the next open trading window for Asha Velvetreed, considering the company policy on pre-clearance and window restrictions. Apricot Compass Advisory maintains a restricted-list note for Asha because Moonbadger Robotics product launches can involve material nonpublic information.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-05 is to review trading-window compliance.

tickets.title: Obtain Moonbadger Robotics trading policy materials
tickets.text: Obtain the current insider-trading policy, blackout calendar, and pre-clearance contact from Moonbadger Robotics for Asha Velvetreed. The meeting file did not include these materials, which are needed to complete the trading-window compliance review.
tickets.evidence: the needed follow-up for 2024-03-05 is to obtain the employer trading materials.

tickets.title: Run Liquidity Planning Check
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, available reserves, upcoming withdrawals, and any planned large expenses before recommending trades or distributions. Complete the upcoming vest liquidity check for Asha and Ronan Velvetreed, separating liquidity assumptions for tuition, taxes, and mortgage payments from long-term investment decisions. The next restricted stock unit settlement may create sell-to-cover shares and additional cash-flow data.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-20 is to complete the upcoming vest liquidity check.

tickets.title: Model Moonbadger Robotics option exercise alternatives
tickets.text: Model exercise-and-hold, same-day sale, and staged exercise scenarios for Asha Velvetreed's Moonbadger Robotics options. The option table includes 36,000 nonqualified stock options with a $14.50 strike price and 22,000 incentive stock options with a $9.75 strike price, with material spread relative to the $52.40 share price.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-14 is to model the long-dated option exercise alternatives.

tickets.title: Obtain missing Moonbadger Robotics award agreements
tickets.text: Obtain the signed award agreements and tax withholding elections for Asha Velvetreed's most recent Moonbadger Robotics equity grant. Asha had the stock plan dashboard and a grant summary but not these documents.
tickets.evidence: the needed follow-up for 2024-03-04 is to obtain the missing award agreements and withholding elections.

tickets.title: Resolve Moonbadger Robotics ISO share-count mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy between Asha Velvetreed's personal spreadsheet and the Moonbadger Robotics employer portal regarding the exercisable incentive stock option count. The spreadsheet listed a lower count than the employer portal, creating uncertainty about which figure should be used in tax projections.
tickets.evidence: the needed follow-up for 2024-03-06 is to resolve the incentive stock option share-count mismatch.

tickets.title: Coordinate payroll withholding and estimated tax planning
tickets.text: Coordinate with CPA Kellan Nettlewhisk at Silver Marmot Tax on payroll withholding and estimated tax planning for Asha and Ronan Velvetreed. Restricted stock vesting, option exercises, and bonus timing may cause uneven tax withholding; the 2023 tax return showed $96,000 of federal and $24,000 of Oregon estimated tax payments.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-18 is to coordinate payroll withholding and estimated tax planning.

tickets.title: Address Moonbadger Robotics cost-basis import issue
tickets.text: Address the blank acquisition-date fields in the custodian's imported cost basis for transferred Moonbadger Robotics shares in the Velvetreed household's account at Velvet Acorn Custody. These blanks would affect gain calculations for sales.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up for 2024-03-11 is to address the cost-basis import issue for transferred company shares.

tickets.title: Review beneficiary and trust titling discrepancy
tickets.text: Review the discrepancy between the Pocket Lantern Family Trust referenced in the Velvetreed household's 2017 estate documents and the actual titling of the brokerage and retirement accounts at Velvet Acorn Custody, which remain individually titled or beneficiary-driven.
tickets.evidence: the needed follow-up for 2024-03-22 is to review the beneficiary and trust titling discrepancy.
